ShortDescription.Value: Select road nodes to outline any perimeter, then generate a perfectly-fitted grid of internal streets — cul-de-sacs, organic variation and full curve control included. Available in 16 languages.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Grid Road Generator
Select several existing road nodes — the corners of any perimeter (rectangle, L-shape, rotated, irregular) — then confirm to generate a perfect grid of inner roads, oriented on the perimeter's longest edge and clipped to its boundaries.
## Geometry - **Fit to area** (rows/columns spread evenly) or **fixed spacing** (distance in meters, road count computed automatically) - Columns, rows, spacing, additional angle offset - Follow terrain, or keep the generated grid flat at the perimeter's average elevation
## Cul-de-sac (suburban layout) - Turns the cross streets into dead ends instead of through streets - Depth, frequency and staggering (alternates between the near/far collector street) - Turnaround circle at the end of each cul-de-sac: automatic size (follows road width) or manual, in asphalt, grass or tree-lined style
## Organic variation - Jitter: deterministic pseudo-random offset of the internal lines, with a "new seed" button - Curve amount and style for the collector streets: a one-sided bulge, or an S-curve - Orientation: fixed angle, or an experimental "follow terrain" mode recomputed at generation time
## Road selection - Uses whichever road prefab is selected in the vanilla road tool by default, or pick one explicitly from the in-panel selector (search, categories, recently used)
## View - Toggle underground networks, the zone grid and normally-invisible networks while the tool is active — same as CS2-NetworkTools' View row - Every selectable road node shows a faint marker before you even hover over it
## Compatibility - **[Anarchy](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/74604/Windows)** by **yenyang** (optional): if installed, a toggle appears in the panel header, synced with Anarchy's own button and shortcut. No hard dependency — nothing changes if Anarchy isn't installed.
## Keybindings (Options > Mods > Grid Road Generator) - **Ctrl+G**: toggle the tool - **Enter**: confirm the perimeter and build the grid - **Left click**: add/remove a node · **Right click**: remove the last node · **Escape**: clear the selection
All other settings (geometry, cul-de-sac, organic variation, road choice) live in the in-game panel itself, not in Options > Mods, and persist between sessions.
## Languages **16 languages** are included: - **12 official game languages**: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional) - **4 community languages**: Portuguese (Portugal), Ukrainian, Thai, Vietnamese — these four only appear if a locale-adding mod (e.g. an I18n mod) is installed
## Credits Node-selection, tooltip and UI architecture patterns adapted from [CS2-NetworkTools](https://github.com/lucarager/CS2-NetworkTools) by Luca Rager, under the MIT license. Thank you!
Publish.ChangeLog: Initial release: - Grid generation on any perimeter (rectangle, L-shape, rotated, irregular), fit-to-area or fixed spacing - Cul-de-sac (suburban) mode with configurable depth, frequency, staggering and turnaround style/size - Organic variation: jitter, collector curve amount/style (bulge or S-curve), terrain-follow orientation - In-panel road prefab picker, draggable/collapsible panel with a native scrollbar - View toggles (underground, zone grid, invisible networks) and selectable-node markers - Optional Anarchy integration - Reassignable keybindings (Ctrl+G, Enter) and 16 languages
